name: nova-runtime
description: NOVA Runtime — local backend for the NOVA Console prototype. Real SQLite persistence, real Ollama-backed streaming inference, real CPU/RAM/GPU telemetry. Zero npm dependencies by design — everything here runs on what Node 22+ ships built in (node:sqlite, global fetch, node:http), so there is nothing to install and nothing that can fail to compile on your machine.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
